n: Perkins School for the Blind unplugged coding activities
t: Tactile sequencing activities for students with visual impairments, using cards and cups.
steps: Find the Perkins School for the Blind blog post on sequencing coding activities.
Read the post from start to finish.
Make a tactile card that shows the cup stack to rebuild.
Prepare a tactile grid page for the route activity.
Try the activity yourself with a colleague before class.
